universe_audit.liquidity_formula: all lifecycle-valid ETFs' three-day mean total amount / 15000
universe_audit.dynamic_proxy: lifecycle-valid sector/cross-border/commodity ETFs, deduplicated by current static tracking_target and ranked by causal ADV3; original name-cleaning cannot be exact because local master names contain irreversible source encoding loss

causality: observation close and earlier -> next trading day adjusted open
schedule: full-sample trading-day anchor at 2015-01-01; no trades or partial-fill continuation on non-rebalance dates
weak_regime: direct daily 3-of-4 below causal MA10; no A4 hysteresis
survivorship: daily listing/delisting lifecycle filter; historical delisted ETFs retained
adjustment: continuous adjusted open/close; raw RMB amount
platform_source_note: source.py is the JoinQuant fixed-pool transfer work package; engine.py is the exact local original_like proxy used for archived metrics
